worldcombat.skill.chatter.summary: Scream a string of shrill bursts across a fan in front of you: each burst deals sound damage on its own, and anyone caught is left confused at once — every attempt to act may fizzle, and landing a hit hurts them with their own strength. Sound passes through cover; the price is short range and light individual hits.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.use.0: Press in and rattle a target with several bursts
worldcombat.skill.chatter.use.2: Open a window of fumbles and recoil on a dangerous foe
worldcombat.skill.chatter.description.0: Each burst deals %1$s special damage (sound) to every enemy in the fan; it cries %2$s bursts, one every %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.description.1: The fan opens %1$s degrees and reaches %2$s blocks; sound is not blocked by cover.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.description.2: Those caught are confused for %1$s; while confused they fumble %2$s of their attempts to act and hurt themselves when they land a hit on a non-ally.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.growth.0: From level %1$s each burst rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.growth.1: From level %1$s it cries %2$s bursts at %3$s each.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.growth.2: From level %1$s each burst is %2$s and the confusion lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.chatter.preference.shr: On: reach +2 blocks and confusion ×1.25, but each burst is ×0.92, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks — for long-range suppression. Off: a closer, harder string for point-blank interruption.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it cry off from further away.
On: targets already carrying the confusion identity are deprioritised so the guaranteed string lands on someone still clear-headed. Off: it sorts as an ordinary close-to-mid ranged attack.
